rules.registry: Settled shares after registry-session open orders; no intraday trades assumed.
rules.funding: At each allowed subscription-window open before stock rebalance, allocate only free account cash pro rata to remaining entitlements. No loan, external capital or forced sales. Unfunded rights lapse after the window.
rules.fees: Known offer-declared fees take priority, currently0bp for both documented issuers. The original3bp assumption remains only an explicit fallback when a fee is not supplied; old hypothetical results remain immutable. No subscription slippage or stamp duty is invented.
rules.valuation: Subscription principal stays as a deposit at cost until success is publicly visible and ex-date has occurred; successful locked-share claims then use raw underlying valuation.
rules.availability: Date-only publications become visible next exchange session. Unknown expected result/refund stops the account, not zeroed. New shares tradable only after both listing date and listing-notice availability.
rules.failed_or_cancelled: Do not subscribe after cancellation/failure is visible; previously paid principal returns only after disclosed refund date and publication availability. No assumed refund interest.
rules.comparison: Both policies versioned separately. No return-based default selection or automatic promotion.

rights_coverage: Two documented cases only, not a complete universe of successful, failed or canceled offers.
